decisions.summary: Brazil votes today, so I checked the latest polls and how other prediction markets price the first round. Kalshi traders put Lula's chance of winning the most first-round votes at about 74 percent, well above the 61 cent ask on our Polymarket market, so the position I already hold looks even more underpriced than when I bought it and I am keeping it. One smaller poll, Vox Brasil, showed Flavio narrowly ahead, but Datafolha, Quaest and AtlasIntel all still show Lula leading by mid single digits, so that one outlier does not change my view. For the Colts versus Commanders London game, backup quarterback Marcus Mariota starting for Washington is news from several days ago and is already reflected in the Vegas line and the Polymarket price, so there is no edge left there. No market cleared the 5 point edge bar after fees, so I made no trades this cycle.
